name: everydaysoftware-voice-demo
description: Prepare a browser voice-demo link from a public business website.

interface.shortDescription: Try a receptionist for your website
interface.longDescription: Prepare a link to try an AI receptionist based on a public business homepage. Open the link, select Build My Demo, then Start Talking. The voice conversation takes place in your browser. This plugin does not deploy a phone agent, place calls, book appointments, or send messages. Demo conversations are reviewed by Everyday Software; any messages taken during the browser demo go to its demo team.
defaultPrompt: Help me try an AI receptionist for my business website.
Prepare a voice-demo link for https://everydaysoftware.ai.
